tasks.description: 1.1 Bind the exact 241-path snapshot, existing source heads and proposed candidate bases to Plan-approved isolated roots/owners; record all operations, additions/deletions, modes and exclusions in the source-intake receipt contract. Completion is the finite manifest and ownership record; changed inputs are rebound explicitly, not silently overwritten.

1.2 Materialize UAR's 126 selected paths on the approved a7cb9729 candidate baseline using cand-001, then create its scoped checkpoint with required attribution. Completion is the exact candidate commit and a content/mode inventory matching the selected source delta, without touching the original source index or forbidden F6 files.

1.3 Materialize Bossfang's 72 selected paths on accepted bac04cb6 using cand-001/cand-002 and create its scoped checkpoint. Completion is the candidate commit plus explicit 279-commit inherited-baseline disclosure and preserved old main ref, not a fabricated phase-only backport.

1.4 Materialize Boss's 43 selected paths on approved 822ed999 candidate baseline, retaining its target-only commits and migrated exact-approval callers, then create its scoped checkpoint. Completion is the scoped commit and paired producer/consumer inventory; do not edit the local-UAR pin owned by change02 here.

1.5 Publish the source-intake receipt locally for the payload producer, linking all three candidate commits, selected-path digests, unchanged source/primary state and prior evidence at its real boundary. Completion is the schema-conforming receipt and local handoff; tests/review/certification remain deferred and publication unclaimed.

context:
Isolated Bossfang–UAR authorization and execution-ownership remediation workstream.
The architectural review dated 2026-10-06 is the initial evidence ledger.
Cover local desktop and remote multi-user deployments; retain every finding F1–F7
and every acceptance scenario, including conditions and disconfirming evidence.
Distinguish model providers, execution harnesses and job orchestrators.
Reuse existing UAR full-harness, owner-bound MCP and exact admission mechanisms.
Apply each product repository constitution in its own future isolated worktree.
KBD/tooling uses Node LTS, no shell/Python scripts or new resident services.
OpenSpec is required. Do not replace it with another backend.
No direct writes to generated KBD state: use typed canonical commands.
No product source changes until the Plan handover is explicitly approved.
Complete production behavior before its real-path integration gate; no fixture
or static result certifies a deployed multi-user stack.
Execute all stages: Assess, Analyze, Spec, Plan, Execute, Reflect.
Stop after each stage for explicit user approval; never infer approval from
elapsed time or a completed handoff. No publication or deployment authorization.
